rationale: The target is a faithful distribution-level formalization of Definition 2.2.1 and its immediately following affine-equivalence paragraph. It constructs a canonical real PMF with exactly half its mass at -1 and half at 1, and it identifies that law as the pushforward of the usual Bernoulli(p) PMF under the 0↦-1, 1↦1 recoding exactly for p=1/2. The use of PMFs and Bool removes an irrelevant ambient probability-space realization without changing the law-level content. Extra moment fields present in the underlying model structure are not projected into the target proposition and therefore do not strengthen it.
